info.title: Quadrasense PI integration API
info.description: Primary Inventory's machine interface for the systems of the SIM and eSIM estate: Lodestone (IEH) first, and Tessera (PDC) where it is registered directly. OAuth 2.0 client credentials; every identifier in a request body, never a URL. See docs/integration/PI-API-CATALOG.md.

post.summary: OAuth 2.0 client credentials: a registered system's id and secret for a bearer token.

requestBody.description: RFC 6749 §4.4.2. The client authenticates with HTTP Basic, or with client_id and client_secret here.

scope.description: Space-separated scopes; all the client holds when left out.

client_id.description: The client's id, when not sent with HTTP Basic.

client_secret.description: The client's secret, when not sent with HTTP Basic.

post.summary: A number, SIM (IMSI or ICCID) or handset: its bindings, active and ended, with derived ICCIDs and each handset's model, type and capabilities.
Several identifiers at once, each answered as a lookup or refused on its own.
Every number, SIM and handset connected to one identifier, with counts.
Every binding of one identifier over time, and what CRM declared about it.

get.summary: What a TAC is: make, model, device type and capabilities, from the active GSMA catalogue.

post.summary: The device and SIM facts a policy decision is written against: observations, never a decision.
One day's binding adds and removes, a page at a time, for a copy kept in step.

get.summary: PI's events after a cursor, oldest first: inventory.day-imported, catalogue.version-activated.

post.summary: CRM's SIM swaps, activations and deactivations, delivered by Lodestone. Idempotent by event id.

get.summary: The calling client, its scopes, and how fresh PI's data is.
Each daily file judged against the ordinary days: shifted IMEIs, SIMs with several numbers, malformed IMEIs.
Data-quality signals over the current state: invalid identifiers, contradictions, binding lifetimes.

oneOf.description: For a valid one, the lookup.

BatchLookupItem.description: One identifier of a batch, resolved or refused.

identifiers.description: At most the configured batch size.

items.description: One per identifier sent, in order.

delivery.description: The delivery sequence it came in.

cursor.description: The `next` of the previous page; left out for the first.

limit.description: Changes in the page; the configured default when left out.

BindingChangesRequest.description: A page of one day's binding changes to read.

next.description: The cursor for the next page, or null on the last.

identifiers.description: full, or masked when the token lacks identifiers.reveal.

BindingChangesResponse.description: A page of one day's binding changes.

previousImsi.description: For a swap, the SIM left.

previousIccid.description: For a swap, the SIM left.

DeclaredEventInfo.description: A declared event as PI answers it.

eventId.description: The sender's id, unique per client: the idempotency key.

source.description: The system that declared it, such as `crm`.

occurredAt.description: When it happened, ISO 8601 with an offset.

imsi.description: The SIM by IMSI, or leave it out and name it by ICCID.

previousImsi.description: For a swap: the SIM the number left, by IMSI.

previousIccid.description: For a swap: the SIM the number left, by ICCID.

reference.description: The sender's own reference, such as an order number. Opaque to PI.

DeclaredEventInput.description: One declared event, as Lodestone delivers it from CRM.

problems.description: For an invalid one, why, by field.

DeclaredEventResult.description: The outcome of one declared event delivered.

events.description: At most the configured number per request.

duplicates.description: Stored before with the same content: retries, which are safe.

rejected.description: Invalid, or an id used before for different content. The others were stored.

DeclaredEventsResponse.description: The outcome of a delivery of declared events.

imsEmergency.description: IMS emergency calling. Not VoLTE: the catalogue does not hold VoLTE.

imeiQuantity.description: IMEIs the model carries: two for a dual-SIM handset.

DeviceCapabilitiesInfo.description: A model's capabilities, as the GSMA catalogue records them; null where it does not say.

oneOf.description: Its model; null when the TAC is not in the catalogue and the network has not counted it.

DeviceFactsInfo.description: A handset in an active binding, and its model.

knownToGsma.description: Whether the active catalogue lists it; seen on the network but unlisted otherwise.

deviceType.description: The GSMA device type: Smartphone, Modem, IoT Device and so on.

capabilities.description: What the catalogue says it can do.

DeviceModelInfo.description: A device model: what a TAC is, from the active GSMA catalogue.

malformedImeiRows.description: Rows whose IMEI is neither 14 digits nor the sentinel.

unknownTacRows.description: 14-digit IMEIs with a TAC GSMA does not know.

shiftedImeiRows.description: Of those, IMEIs that look shifted by one digit.

multiNumberSims.description: SIMs with more than one number on the day.

flagged.description: True when any check is out of line.

threshold.description: Above this the day is flagged; null without reference days.

days.description: How many reference days had been measured.

multiplier.description: A rate above this many times the reference days' median is flagged.

minimumRate.description: No rate below this is flagged, 0 to 1.

FeedQualityReferenceInfo.description: The reference window and the rule applied against it.

reference.description: The days the judgement is made against.

FeedQualityResponse.description: Each day's file judged against the ordinary days, and what "ordinary" was.

HandsetCapabilitiesInfo.description:
What a binding's handset can do, by its model in the active GSMA catalogue; null where the catalogue does
not say. The model's full record - bands, SIM slots, NFC - is the device model route's.

identifier.description:
A phone number (10 digits, with or without a country code), an IMSI (15), an ICCID (19) or an IMEI: its 14
digits, 15 with its check digit, or 16 as an IMEISV.

kind.description:
msisdn, imsi, iccid or imei; read from the length when left out. Fifteen digits are an IMSI unless this
says imei.

IdentifierRequest.description: One identifier to resolve. In the body, never the URL (MCI red lines, §2-3 row 7).

IdentifierVisibility.description: Whether identifiers in a response are complete or redacted.

events.description: The events after the cursor, oldest first.

next.description: The cursor to send next: the last sequence returned, or the one sent when nothing was.

oldestAvailable.description: The lowest sequence still kept; a cursor below it means events were missed.

latest.description: The highest sequence issued so far.

IntegrationEventPage.description: A page of PI's event feed.

dataThrough.description: The last day of the binding feed PI holds.

history.description: Ready, Building or NotDeployed: whether lookups and history can be answered.

IntegrationStatusResponse.description: The state of PI's data, for a client deciding whether to read now.

iccid.description: The SIM's ICCID, derived from the IMSI by the operator's numbering; null when it does not apply.

iccidSource.description: Always `derived`: no feed PI receives carries ICCIDs.

tac.description: The handset's model: its first eight digits.

brand.description: The model's brand, from the active GSMA catalogue.

deviceType.description: The model's GSMA device type: Smartphone, Modem, IoT Device and so on.

oneOf.description: What the model can do; null when the active catalogue does not list the TAC.

firstSeen.description: The first day the feed named this binding.

firstSeenIsDumpWindow.description: That day is the initial dump's.

InventoryBindingInfo.description: One binding: a number, a SIM and a handset together.

identifier.description: The identifier as PI holds it: a number as its ten digits, an IMEI as its fourteen; an ICCID as sent.

resolvedImsi.description: For an ICCID, the IMSI it resolves to.

networkAgeDays.description: Days since the feed first named it; null when it came from the initial dump.

devices.description: The handsets of its active bindings, with their models and capabilities.

oneOf.description: PI's risk measures for it and the evidence level they reach - an observation, not a verdict; null when they are unavailable.

riskUnavailable.description: Why risk measures are missing, when they are.

declared.description: What CRM declared about the number or the SIM, newest first.

identifiers.description: full, or masked when the token lacks identifiers.reveal.

dataThrough.description: The last day of the binding feed PI holds.

InventoryFactsResponse.description:
The facts a policy decision is written against (Tessera): what PI observed, never a decision. Whether
something is eligible, blocked or grey-listed is Tessera's to say.

identifier.description: The identifier as PI holds it: a number as its ten digits, an IMEI as its fourteen; an ICCID as sent.

resolvedImsi.description: For an ICCID, the IMSI it resolves to.

timeline.description: The observed history, as the Explorer's timeline draws it.

declared.description: What CRM declared about the number or the SIM, newest first; empty for a handset.

InventoryHistoryResponse.description: One identifier's history: every binding over time, and what was declared about it.

identifier.description: The identifier as PI holds it: a number as its ten digits, an IMEI as its fourteen; an ICCID as sent.

resolvedImsi.description: For an ICCID, the IMSI the operator's numbering derives it from.

bindings.description: Its bindings, most recently changed first.

truncated.description: More bindings exist than were returned.

identifiers.description: full, or masked when the token lacks identifiers.reveal.

dataThrough.description: The last day of the binding feed PI holds.

InventoryLookupResponse.description: What PI knows of one identifier: its bindings, now and before.

bindings.description: Number + SIM + handset combinations ever held.

firstSeen.description: The first day the feed named it.

firstSeenIsDumpWindow.description: The first day is the initial dump's, which covers a month, not a day.

lastChange.description: The last day one of its bindings changed.

marketingName.description: Its model, which will match the centre's.

sharedSubscribers.description:
How many phone numbers have been seen on both. This is the evidence: it is what distinguishes
a real pair from two handsets that merely came off the line one after another.

PairedHandset.description: Two IMEIs shown to be the two radios of one physical handset.

QualityBaseInfo.description: A population a category is measured against.

meaning.description: What a binding in it is.

periods.description:
For a history category, how often it happened (periods of a length, redundant adds,
            orphan removes); for current state, 0.

share.description: Bindings over the base's bindings, 0 to 1; null when the base is empty.

available.description: False until a run with quality categories has been published.

reason.description: Why nothing is available, for a person; null when available.

runId.description: The run the counts come from.

bases.description: The populations the categories are shares of: all, active, history_all.

categories.description: Every category in the catalogue, in display order, zero when none.

QualitySignalsResponse.description: The data-quality categories of the newest published measures run, or why there are none.

RelatedKind.description: Which of the three identifiers a node is.

bindings.description: How many bindings join it to the centre.

activeBindings.description: How many of those are still in force.

lastConfirmed.description:
The day a daily file last said anything about it, or null when none ever has - meaning it is
present only because the initial dump listed it and nothing has removed it since.

tac.description: For a handset, its type allocation code.

brand.description: For a handset, the GSMA brand.

marketingName.description: For a handset, the product name.

deviceType.description: For a handset, the GSMA device type.

RelatedNode.description: One identifier connected to the one being explored.

found.description: False when the identifier is well-formed but appears nowhere.

paired.description: Handsets shown to share a physical device with one of the above.

withheld.description:
Sections the caller is not permitted to see, named rather than silently dropped - an empty
list and a forbidden list look identical otherwise, and the difference matters.

truncated.description: True when the identifier has more bindings than the server will return.

rowsExamined.description: Rows the engine read. The number that tells an index from a scan.

identifiers.description: Whether the neighbours' identifiers are complete or redacted. The centre is always as typed.

name.description: The key in each row's values.

stored.description: False when it has no stored row: every measure is below its storage floor.

assessable.description: False when most of its evidence was set aside as feed defects.

reasons.description: Every measured rule, highest level first.

values.description: Its stored measures, by column name.

asOf.description: yyyy-MM-dd the measures are as of.

pattern.description:
The level of this entity together with those bound to it in the 30 days: SuspiciousPattern when
risk signals of two different families hold among them, otherwise the highest of their levels up
to RiskSignal.

linked.description: Per family, how many bound entities have stored measures, and at which levels. Names nobody.

RiskEntityResponse.description: One entity's risk measures and verdicts.

stored.description: How many have stored measures; the rest are below every floor.

RiskLinkedInfo.description: The entities of one family bound to an entity in the 30 days, counted by level.

threshold.description: What it was compared with; null when the rule has none.

RiskReasonInfo.description: One rule's verdict on one entity.

source.description: SQM (the binding feed) or TAC (the GSMA catalogue).

msisdn.description: Null when withheld; masked without identifier.reveal.

imsi.description: Null when withheld; masked without identifier.reveal.

imei.description: Null when withheld; masked without identifier.reveal.

brand.description: GSMA brand; null when GSMA does not know the TAC.

model.description: GSMA marketing name; null when GSMA does not know the TAC.

active.description: Not yet removed by the feed, from current state. Not proof the SIM is in the handset today.

firstSeen.description: yyyy-MM-dd: its first event, or the dump window's first day.

firstSeenIsDumpWindow.description: FirstSeen stands for the dump window.

lastChange.description: yyyy-MM-dd of its last event; null when no daily file mentioned it.

periods.description: When the feed held it active.

TimelineBindingInfo.description: One binding - a number, a SIM and a handset together - over time.

effect.description: "applied", "redundant" (an add of something already held) or "orphan" (a remove of something not held).

TimelineEventInfo.description: One dated change from a daily file.

kind.description: msisdn, imsi or imei: what the group is of.

drillable.description: The key is complete and can be opened.

tac.description: For a handset group: its model allocation.

brand.description: For a handset group: GSMA brand.

model.description: For a handset group: GSMA marketing name.

bindings.description: How many bindings the group combines.

active.description: Any of them not yet removed.

firstSeen.description: yyyy-MM-dd, the earliest of its bindings.

firstSeenIsDumpWindow.description: FirstSeen stands for the dump window.

lastChange.description: yyyy-MM-dd, the latest event of any of its bindings.

periods.description: When any of its bindings was held: overlapping and same-day periods joined.

TimelineGroupInfo.description: Every binding sharing one related identifier - one SIM of a number, say - combined.

start.description: yyyy-MM-dd: the day it was added, or the initial dump window's first day.

startsInDump.description: The start is the initial dump's window, not a known day.

end.description: yyyy-MM-dd: the day the feed removed it; null while it has not.

TimelinePeriodInfo.description: A stretch of time over which the feed held a binding, or any binding of a group, as active.

tac.description: For a handset: its model allocation.

model.description: For a handset: GSMA marketing name.

summary.description: The figures for the whole timeline.

groups.description: The bindings combined by each related kind the caller may see.

bindings.description: Every binding, most recently changed first.

truncated.description: More bindings exist than MaxBindings; the most recent are shown.

withheld.description: Related kinds left out because the caller may not look them up.

masked.description: Identifiers are redacted: the caller lacks identifier.reveal.

dumpWindowStart.description: yyyy-MM-dd, the initial dump's first day.

dataThrough.description: yyyy-MM-dd, the latest day in the event log.

TimelineResponse.description: A number's, SIM's or handset's history, binding by binding and grouped by what it was bound to.

firstSeenIsDumpWindow.description: FirstSeen stands for the dump window.

lastChange.description: yyyy-MM-dd, the latest event; null when no daily file mentioned it.

handsets.description: Different IMEIs - not phones: a dual-SIM phone has two.

redundantAdds.description: Adds of bindings already held; mostly the dump being a month, not a moment.

stateDisagreements.description:
Bindings whose events end in a different state from current state. Zero
            unless a day is part way through being imported.

TokenError.description: A refused token request, as RFC 6749 §5.2 writes it.

TokenResponse.description: An access token, as RFC 6749 §5.1 writes it.

oauth2.description: A registered system's id and secret for a 15-minute bearer token (RFC 6749 §4.4).

scopes.events.write: Deliver declared events - SIM swaps, activations, deactivations - to PI.
scopes.facts.read: Read the device and SIM facts a policy decision is written against.
scopes.identifiers.reveal: Receive IMSIs, ICCIDs and IMEIs in full; without it they are masked.
scopes.inventory.read: Look up numbers, SIMs (IMSI or ICCID) and handsets: their bindings, relationships, history and device models.
scopes.inventory.sync: Read each day's binding changes, to keep a copy in step.
scopes.quality.read: Read data-quality figures and the state of the feeds.
